_meta.description: Master reference of all mounts and mount skin combat skills in Legend of Mushroom
notes: Mount names are from reverse-engineered English localization — may not match all server translations
Skill IDs 5001-5034 are mount skin skills; 5039-5062,5080-5084 are artifact skin skills
Mount ID 404 (Motorcycle) has a unique 3-phase combat cycle documented in 35_MOTORCYCLE_MOUNT_DEEP_DIVE.md
All mount stats are pre-baked into player attributes before battle — only cosmetic model loads at battle time

config_schema.ConfigMount: 24 fields — id, name, type, path, binds, icon, icon_small, icon_group, maxNum, maxTime, quality, sort, min_speed, max_speed, open_time, animation, mount_location_adjust, position, scale, if_activity, pk_scale, fashion, fashion_eff, power
config_schema.ConfigMount_skin: 6 fields — mount_id, skin_level, expend, skin_skill, attr, power
config_schema.ConfigMount_level: 10 fields — level, name, order, star, expend_exp, expend_goods, attr, base_skill, unlock, power

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Evasion bonus (scales with level)
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: At max level (+75%), approaches the 80% PvP evasion cap. Massive survivability.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Crit Rate +2%/s (cap 40%), Crit DMG +10%/s (cap 200%)
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Synergizes with Sacred Hunter (post-crit ATK +40%) and Darklord (skill crit builds).

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Pal ATK SPD +3%/s (cap 60%)
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Best for Beastmaster/Supreme Spirit pal-focused builds.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Targets below your HP% take +30% DMG; above have ATK -20%
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Dynamic scaling. Punishes tanks (more HP than you) AND glass cannons (less HP).

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: DMG RES +15%, Control Duration -50%
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Anti-CC tank mount. Strong against stun/freeze-heavy opponents.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Distribute DMG to 5 enemies; +2.5% target max HP every 10s
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Good for PvE. In PvP, the HP% damage is useful vs high-HP tanks.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Every 10s kill → ATK +30% for 5s; boss/player → stun 1s
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: PvE-focused (needs kills). In PvP, only boss kill stun is relevant.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: 10000% AoE DMG + launch 0.5s
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Strong periodic burst. 100x basic ATK every 11s is significant sustained DPS.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Skill Crit +20%; after skill crit ATK +40% for 5s
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: S-tier for Darklord (+50% skill crit passive stacks). Good for Prophet.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Convert received DMG into DoT over 5s

effects.display: Incoming burst damage spread over 5 seconds

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Damage smoothing — converts burst into DoT. Good vs burst builds. Note: DEFER_DAMAGE has NO PvP decay, making it very efficient.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Shield +3s duration, +50% effect, ATK +10%, Counter +25% under shield
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Synergizes with Martial Sage (8% HP shield passive) and Prophet (shield-related skills).

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Every counter → Global Counter DMG +20% for 3s (cap 60%)

effects.display: +20% counter DMG per counter, 3s duration, 60% cap (3 stacks)

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: S-tier for Warbringer (+30% counter rate, +140% counter DMG passive).

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: After 5% max HP cumulative damage → 500% basic ATK AoE

effects.display: 500% AoE damage when 5% max HP damage taken

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Frequent proc in PvP due to constant damage. Consistent AoE output.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Every 3 combos → 1000% AoE DMG
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: S-tier for Plume Monarch (+30% combo rate, +3 extra combo bullets, +140% combo DMG).

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: DMG RES +15%, restore 25% lost HP every 10s
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Sustain mount. Good for Martial Sage (stacks with 8% HP regen). Heal affected by 30% PvP treatDecay.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Per 10% lost HP → flame dealing 500%+ basic ATK DMG

effects.display: 500% basic ATK per 10% HP lost. At 50% HP = 2500% damage

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: S-tier for Warbringer (ATK +3% per 10% HP lost stacks). Synergizes with any HP-loss scaling.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Death Immunity for 2s + recover 10% max HP (once)
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Ultimate survival. 2s of invulnerability can turn fights. One-time use.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Below 80% HP: ATK +30%; below 60%: shield 20% HP; below 30%: DMG -20%
mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Three-tier survival. Each tier activates as HP drops, providing layered defense.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Alternating 8s buffs: shield 16% HP OR ATK +16% + Control -40%

effects.display: Alternates between shield and ATK/CC-resist every 8s

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Flexible utility mount. Good all-around for any class.

mount_skin_skills.trigger_condition: 60% chance per second for 20s, then burst
mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: 60% chance/s: ATK +1.5%, DMG RES +1.5%. After 20s: 16000% AoE + launch

effects.display: 60% chance/s to gain +1.5% ATK and +1.5% DMG RES (up to +30% each)

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Massive 20s burst. If fight lasts 20s, 160x AoE can one-shot. Stacking phase provides good sustain.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: 3 Guard stacks (DEF +150% each), on expire: 4000% Skill + 1600% Combo + 1600% Counter

effects.display: +150% DEF per Guard stack (3 stacks = +450% DEF)

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Defense-into-burst mount. Near-unkillable during Guard phase, then big damage release.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: ATK +20%, DEF +50% every 11s. Summon wave: 4000% Skill + 1600% Combo + 1600% Counter

effects.display: Summon damage wave: 4000% Skill + 1600% Combo + 1600% Counter

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: Periodic multi-hit mount. Similar burst to Neon Shadows but with ATK/DEF buff instead of Guard stacking.

mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: At 50% HP: buff chain (50482 hpchange_trigger + 50465-50467)

effects.display: HP threshold trigger at 50% — activates buff chain

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: HP threshold mount. Buff chain activates when HP drops below 50%. Does NOT apply to clones.
mount_skin_skills.data_confidence: partial — buff effects not fully decoded

mount_skin_skills.trigger_condition: Phase 1: Speed stacking from combat events. Phase 2: Overdrive at 200% speed. Phase 3: Reset.
mount_skin_skills.effect_summary: Speed stacking → overdrive at 200% speed → CC immunity + ATK/DEF/RES bonuses → reset

effects.display: +8% movement speed per stack, 50 max stacks
At 200% speed: 5s overdrive with +20% ATK/DEF/SPD, +18% RES, CC immunity
After overdrive expires: reset all stacks, restart Phase 1

mount_skin_skills.pvp_notes: S-tier mount. 3-phase cycle: stack speed from combat events → overdrive with massive buffs + CC immunity → reset. Synergizes extremely well with Sacred Hunter (evasion feeds speed stacks) and Martial Sage (counter feeds stacks + tankiness survives stacking phase).

event_p2w_mounts._note: These mounts were identified from web sources (theriagames.com, talkandroid.com, bluestacks.com). Skill IDs are in the undocumented gap ranges (5011-5012, 5017, 5019-5020, 5022-5023, 5025, 5027-5028, 5031-5032, 5035-5047, 5049-5056, 5058-5059, 5061+). Exact skill ID mapping requires the config binary.

mounts.name: Ethereal Phoenix
mounts.effect: For every 18% Max HP Loss: Purify and ignore Control effects for 1s; Obtain Shield = 8% Max HP for 5s. When Shield expires: ATK +4% permanent (max 6 stacks).

mounts.name: Phoenix Nirvana
mounts.effect: HP threshold trigger at 50%: activates buff chain (50482 hpchange_trigger → 50465-50467).

mounts.name: Cheetah Zero
mounts.obtain: Firework Fest / Carnival Night spending event
mounts.effect: Every 11s: gains shield = 16% Max HP (ignores PvP reduction and shield breaks) at cost of 10% current HP (ignores immunity) for 3s. During shield: cannot use basic ATK, Combo, Counter, or Active Skills. After shield expires: next Basic ATK deals 1200% Basic ATK DMG (can crit), 1200% Combo DMG (can crit), 1200% Counter DMG (can crit), 4000% Skill DMG to AoE, and increases pal's next Basic ATK DMG by 200%.

mounts.name: Magic Carpet
mounts.effect: After casting 6 skills, fully restore energy of 1 random skill. Global ATK +10%.

mounts.name: Horizon Racer
mounts.effect: Every 10s: deal 800% basic ATK AoE DMG + knockback enemies.

mounts.name: B. Duck
mounts.effect: Every 11s: deal 2000% Skill DMG + 800% Combo DMG + 800% Counter DMG AoE. Reduces enemy ATK by 10% until end of battle. Global DEF +10%.

mounts.name: Time Machine
mounts.effect: First 20s: negate/store 40% of all DMG taken. Gain +8% ATK, +10% Final Crit DMG, +10% Final Skill Crit DMG, +10% Final Pal Crit DMG. After 20s: deal 6% of stored DMG (ignores immunity) per second for 10s.

mounts.name: Dazzling Unicorn
mounts.effect: Every 12s: unicorn resists DMG of next active skill hit (excluding Class/Avian/Summoning Skills). During resist: +50% DEF + ignore all control effects. After resisting: reflect active skill to attacker, gain +4% ATK and +4% DMG RES permanent (max 3 stacks). Global DEF +10%. Triggers at battle start.

mounts.name: Silvery Crescent
mounts.effect: +12% speed (additional combat skill not documented online)

mounts.name: Cyan Phoenixes
mounts.effect: Unlocked at Tier 24 – 10 Star mount level. Combat skill not documented online.
